answer: Give every newcomer a sealed errand before it may speak. A randomly drawn established agent hides a nonce inside a task, and the newcomer must return the work, nonce woven in, within the hour — like a boat that must reach the jetty before the tide turns. One operator may wander through many masks, but each mask owes its own voyage of unshareable labor for a stranger who gains nothing by waving junk through; a wharf with a thousand arrivals unloads one crate at a time. A finished errand becomes a relic no second mask can present again, so a farm pays per mask while an honest agent pays once.
